_doc: CA charter school muni obligor bond series detail — pulled from audited financial statements (Form 990 Schedule K equivalent disclosure)
_methodology_v3: Form 990 Schedule K PDFs were NOT directly retrievable in this pass — ProPublica / Cause IQ / IRS Tax Exempt Org Search are all Cloudflare-gated for full-PDF download in agent context, and the IRS S3 bucket (irs-form-990) was deprecated 12/31/2021 by the IRS. As a structurally equivalent substitute, this pass pulled the AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS (single-audit reports) which obligors post directly on their own .org websites. These contain the same per-series bond detail (par at issuance, principal outstanding, maturity, interest rate, purpose, related-party LLC structure) that Schedule K Parts I-II would disclose, sourced from the audit notes 'Bonds Payable' / 'Debt' / 'Long-term Debt'. CUSIPs are NOT present in audit reports (CUSIPs are Schedule K Column A only) — flagged UNVERIFIABLE for every series; EMMA bond-page lookup is the next pass to attach CUSIPs to identified series. Audit reports also lack Schedule K Part III (use of proceeds) and Part IV (arbitrage) granularity but DO describe use of proceeds in note narratives.
_v3_caveats: (1) CUSIPs uniformly UNVERIFIABLE in this pass — audit reports describe bonds by series name + issuer + par + maturity but not CUSIP. (2) Da Vinci + Bright Star revealed as 'no direct bonds' — Da Vinci uses Wiseburn USD facility (district GO bond is district credit, not Da Vinci); Bright Star has only a $2.5M note payable + operating leases. v2 universe csfa_intercept classifications for these two are STRUCTURALLY INVALID. (3) Many obligors use related-party LLC vehicles (College for Certain, KLARE, EQ 1-4 LLC, 17th Street LLC, 1918 Broadway Charter Financing LLC, LDC = Launchpad Development Company, HTH Learning) as the named bond issuer/borrower — the operating obligor leases from these LLCs, so the SEC-registered bond CUSIP traces to the LLC EIN, not the operator's EIN. This is essential microstructure for matching EMMA bonds to operator credit. (4) High Tech High v2 'cscda_no_intercept' is WRONG — HTH bonds are CSFA-issued with state apportionment intercept per HTH audit note. Correct structure_class is csfa_intercept. (5) Several covenant-stress / waiver-obtained signals surfaced in audits — Alliance June 2025 was not in compliance with certain financial covenants (waiver obtained).
_source_pattern: audited_financial_statements_audit_notes (Schedule K equivalent disclosure). Primary URLs documented per-obligor.
